q1_issues.issue: (Past sk_bury_1) puts a tense atom on the participial reduced relative "bodies buried beneath …", but tense atoms are restricted to finite clauses and a participial reduced relative tenses nothing.
"beneath freshly poured concrete" is flattened to (Location sk_bury_1 sk_concrete_1), so the stated under-relation is silently dropped rather than kept as the surface preposition.
"freshly" is dropped with no carrier, so the parse records only that the concrete was poured, not that it was newly poured.

q2_gaps: an adverb modifying an attributive participle ("freshly poured concrete") — Manner attaches to events, and a participial adjective has no modifier slot
a modified bare-mass NP inside an oblique ("beneath freshly poured concrete") — the oblique rule keeps a bare mass as a constant, but a constant gives the modifier no bearer

whether a non-containment spatial preposition on an EVENT ("buried beneath X") takes Location or the surface-preposition head is unsettled; the entity-attached side is explicitly containment-only, but the event-side Location gloss ("in/at/on …") is not
notes: The say-attitude routing is right: Experiencer holder, complement sealed under Theme, and only the definite basement's typing projected while the indefinite house and search stay inside. "A search for three missing teenagers" correctly uses the noun-argument oblique (For …) with the counted group and a sealed per-member rule for "missing".
